artworks.title: Charlotte Corday
artworks.medium: color wash manner on wove paper
artworks.description: The woman in the portrait is shown facing forward with delicate features, fair complexion, rosy cheeks, light blue eyes, and brown hair partially covered by a white bonnet. She is wearing a white blouse and a deep red shawl draped over her shoulders, with a soft, muted gradient background within an oval frame against a plain off-white backdrop.

artworks.title: Le Triomphe de Minette (Triumph of Minette)
artworks.medium: color etching and mezzotint inked à la poupée on laid paper

artworks.title: Le concert
artworks.artist: Jean-Claude-Richard, Abbé de Saint-Non after Hubert François Gravelot
artworks.description: This is an image of a musical performance in a decorated room. The drawing shows a group of musicians, with one standing holding a sheet of music next to a cello and another musician playing the instrument. The room is ornate, with a chandelier, wall moldings, and an audience seated to one side. The setting suggests a refined ambiance typical of sophisticated gatherings. The composition captures a moment of cultural engagement during a musical performance.

artworks.title: La cruche cassee
artworks.description: The image shows a young woman standing. She faces forward with a slight angle, hands clasped around a pail she holds in front of her. She has a calm expression, with hair styled in an updo adorned with a flower, wearing a loose-fitting dress. In the background, there is a stone fountain with a sculpted lion's head from which water flows, and some trees are visible. The portrait is enclosed within an oval design.

artworks.title: La laitiere
artworks.artist: Jean Charles Levasseur after Jean-Baptiste Greuze
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up positioned within a large circular frame. She is leaning over a horse's neck with one arm resting upon it while her other arm is by her side. Her facial expression is neutral, with soft features and slightly downturned eyes, as her lips remain closed. The woman wears a light-colored headscarf that wraps around her curly hair and matches her flowing, gathered dress, which is detailed with folds and a low neckline. The horse next to her has a dark coat, a white muzzle, and is wearing a simple bridle. Behind her, there are baskets filled with cloth or fabric. In the background, there are lightly sketched clouds that complement the classical style of the engraving.

artworks.title: La premiere lecon d'amour
artworks.artist: Nicolas Joseph Voyez after Jean-Baptiste Greuze
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman sitting with her body slightly leaned forward. Her hands are on a book in her lap, and her head is turned towards something in front of her. She has delicate facial features, wide eyes, and a small mouth. Her hair is partially covered by a headscarf or bonnet, showing some curls. She is wearing a long dress with loose sleeves and a shawl falling off her shoulders. Nearby, a small table holds two birds, possibly doves. There is a draped cloth on the table edge. In the background, there is a chest of drawers with a round container and a bottle on top. The room has a classic style with wall paneling and a luxurious chair. The setting is dimly lit, emphasizing the woman.

artworks.title: La philosophie endormie
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting in an ornate chair. She appears asleep or at rest, with her head tilted back, eyes closed, and mouth slightly open. Her hair is styled in loose curls and she wears a long, flowing dress with intricate detailing, ruffles at the collar and cuffs. A small animal rests on her lap. Nearby are a hat with feathers, a table with books, and in the background are more books and a globe. The background is textured.

artworks.title: The Tender Desire (Le Tendre désir)
artworks.artist: Manuel Salvador Carmona after Jean-Baptiste Greuze
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a woman shown from the waist up. She is in a reclined pose, with her head turned upwards. Her facial features are soft and delicate, and her hair is styled in loose waves. She is wearing a draped garment that reveals part of her shoulder and chest. Surrounding her is an ornate oval frame with floral designs. Below the portrait, there are decorative elements, including a coat of arms and two cherubs. The background inside the frame is plain, while the outer area features floral and ornamental artwork.

artworks.title: La voluptueuse
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body view of a woman leaning slightly to one side with her right hand raised near her mouth. Her facial features include a softly smiling expression, gently arched eyebrows, and eyes that are partially closed. She has curly hair styled up and adorned with small flowers. The woman is dressed in a loose-fitting garment that drapes over her shoulders, revealing the upper part of her chest. She is framed within an oval ornate border embellished with carved flowers and leaves. Below the main image is a smaller circular illustration featuring a reclining figure surrounded by floral arrangements. The background consists of decorative floral motifs.

artworks.title: Le baiser envoyé
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Jean-Baptiste Greuze
artworks.description: The image shows a person leaning against a window frame, holding a pipe. The person has a composed expression, curly hair with flowers, and is wearing a flowing garment with exposed shoulders. Beside them is a vase of blooming flowers. The background includes a curtain framing the scene.

artworks.title: L'Amant écouté
artworks.description: The image shows two people, one man and one woman. The man is kneeling beside the seated woman, holding one of her hands. The woman is seated with her body slightly turned toward the man, her head tilted downwards. She has a serene expression and is wearing an off-shoulder gown with a full skirt and an elaborate updo with flowers. She holds a pink flower in one hand. The man has short, wavy hair and is wearing a blue coat, black breeches and stockings, and a white necktie. The scene is set in a room with classic decor, including a chair with a blue cushion, a round table with a silver jug, a glass, and some fruit, a bust sculpture on a pedestal against the wall, vertical wall paneling, and a decorative wall piece. A bouquet of flowers is on the floor beside the table.

artworks.title: L'Eventail cassé
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 34.3 × 26.8 cm (13 1/2 × 10 9/16 in.)
overall (outer framing line): 28 × 22.7 cm (11 × 8 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two people seated on a luxurious couch in an ornate room. One person is a woman wearing a light-colored dress and a black shawl, holding a fan. The other person is a man in a red coat with white ruffled cuffs and knee-length breeches. They are surrounded by elegant furnishings, including a table with pink flowers, a draped dark curtain, and a framed oval painting on the wall. The room also contains a colorful patterned carpet and a small stand holding a handbag tied with blue ribbons.

artworks.title: Les Compliments du jour de l'an
artworks.artist: Louis-Marin Bonnet after Jean-Baptiste Hüet, I
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of individuals around a bed draped with a green canopy with gold trim. At the center, a woman is sitting upright on the bed holding a baby. To her left, a young boy stands holding a hat. Two other children are to the right; one is seated on the lap of a woman wearing a red dress with a shawl. Another woman stands beside the bed wearing a green dress. Behind her, a woman in a yellow dress watches the scene. A table on the left holds a pitcher and a glass, in front of a chair. The floor has a rug and the walls are olive with gold accents.

artworks.title: Les Présents du jour de l'an
artworks.artist: Louis-Marin Bonnet after Jean-Baptiste Hüet, I
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in an indoor setting. A woman in a pink dress and hat stands to the left, and another woman in a striped dress sits in a chair to the right holding a parcel. A man in an elaborate outfit is standing beside her. There are other figures including a child with a drum, and adults around a table with a teapot and cups. The room has wood paneling, wall designs, heavy curtains, and a floral-patterned carpet.

artworks.title: Ce qui est bon a prendre est bon a garder
artworks.artist: Alexandre Chaponnier after Jean-Baptiste Hüet, I
artworks.description: The image shows two people on a bed, with one nude woman and a man in period attire. The woman is reclined on the bed with soft facial features, wavy hair, and a gentle smile. The man in attire leans in closely to her. A small dog with long fur sits on the bed next to them. The backdrop features heavy, ornate drapery surrounding the bed.

artworks.title: Marie-Louise, Empress of the French
artworks.artist: Antoine Maxime Monsaldy after Jean-Baptiste Isabey
artworks.medium: color stipple etching inked à la poupée on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person in an oval frame, depicted from the chest up. The person faces slightly to the viewer's right with a calm expression. They have blue eyes and light brown, curly hair under a headdress. The person wears a light-colored scarf or veil with pink roses and leaves around the head and neckline. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is a gradient from light blue to neutral tones, set against a plain, light background. Below the portrait is text with ornamental embellishments, displaying the name "MARIE LOUISE" in decorative script.

artworks.title: L'agreable neglige
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a relaxed pose, with her head on her right hand and left hand holding a garland of flowers. She has a gentle smile, fair complexion, rosy cheeks, elegant updo with pearls, and wears a light-colored dress with lace. The dress falls off one shoulder, and she wears a string of pearls. The woman is surrounded by pink roses and white flowers. The background is dark blue with an ornate oval frame in gold and brown.

artworks.title: Ah! Laisse-moi donc voir
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman standing close together. The man holds a hat and gestures towards a statue behind him, while the woman also gestures towards the same direction. The man has short, curly light brown hair and wears a dark coat, white shirt, light cravat, and yellow pants. The woman has long, light brown hair with a blue ribbon and flowers, and wears a white gown, yellow gloves, and holds a bouquet of flowers. In the background is a garden with a statue of a bearded figure surrounded by greenery and red flowers.

artworks.title: L'amour
artworks.medium: color aquatint and etching with roulette work
artworks.description: The image shows a cherubic figure stringing a bow, with wings and an innocent expression. The figure is surrounded by flowering shrubs and bushes with pink flowers. Near the figure's feet is a quiver with arrows. In the background are light clouds and two white doves in flight. The scene is contained within an oval frame with the word "L'AMOUR" printed below.

artworks.title: La folie
artworks.medium: color aquatint and etching with roulette work
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a cherubic child in a playful, airborne position. The child is mid-leap or in flight, with arms and legs outstretched, hovering among clouds in a celestial setting. The cherub has a soft, round face with rosy cheeks, small eyes, and curly, light-colored hair. The child is unclothed except for a sheer fabric around the waist. In one hand, the child holds a staff or scepter with a face-like figure. Surrounding the cherub are several white doves in flight. The background includes clouds, a light blue sky, clusters of flowers, and foliage. The composition is framed with an oval outline, with a border and text that reads "LA FOLIE."

artworks.title: La Comparaison
artworks.description: The image shows two women indoors. One woman is seated at a table, while the other stands behind her. The seated woman has light brown curly hair and wears a white gown. The standing woman has curly hair, a hat with feathers, and wears a white blouse with a yellow skirt. Both women have delicate facial features. The room has a wooden table, an ornate chair, a dresser with a bottle, and a wrapped box with red flowers. A blue drape falls from the ceiling in the background.

artworks.title: L'aveu difficile (The Difficult Confession)
artworks.medium: etching and wash manner, printed in blue, red, carmine, yellow, and black inks
artworks.description: The image shows two women in an elegantly furnished room. One woman is seated in an armchair, wearing a white dress and hat. The other woman stands beside her, wearing a light blue dress and hat, holding a flower. A small dog lies at the seated woman's feet. The background features high ceilings, draped curtains, a large window, a portrait on the wall, and a lute resting on the armchair.

artworks.title: L'Indiscretion
artworks.medium: etching and wash manner, printed in blue, red, carmine, yellow, and black inks
